basic_details.job_title: DWCWEO Palnadu Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Asst. cum Data Entry Operator, Chowkidar and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Women and Child Welfare and Empowerment Office Palnadu (DWCWEO Palnadu) has announced 10 vacancies for Asst. cum Data Entry Operator - DCPU, Social Worker-cum-Early Child Educator - SAA, Ayah - SAA, Chowkidar - SAA, and Helper cum Night Watchman - Children home, Piduguralla posts on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates can apply through the prescribed offline process by submitting their applications directly or by registered post to the District Women and Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Chaakirala Mitta, Barampet, Narasaraopet from 14 October 2026 to 23 October 2026 before

age_limit.details: The age limit for all posts is 25 to 44 years .

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Asst. cum Data Entry Operator - DCPU
Helper cum Night Watchman - Children home, Piduguralla

qualification.details: Asst. cum Data Entry Operator - DCPU: 12th pass from a recognized Board/ Equivalent Board with Diploma / Certificate in Computers. Weightage for work experience candidate is desirable. Social Worker-cum-Early Child Educator - SAA: Bachelor/ Post graduate in Social Work/ PG Diploma in Psychology / Early Child Care and Development from a recognized university. Desirable: 2 years experience in women/child protection issues including 1 year working with children; experience working with WD & CW Dept., or an NGO on adoption issues; good rapport with NGOs/Police/Govt Departments; demonstrable commitment to women and child concerns with written & oral communication skills (ability to write and speak fluently English and Telugu); ability to work on a computer and capable of using MS-office package (MSWord and Excel) and the internet. Ayah - SAA: Experience of taking care of infants and children below 6 years. Committed and agile person with no past record of moral turpitude and a person who does not have additions like drinking alcohol, chewing gutka etc. Chowkidar - SAA: Committed and agile person with no past record of moral turpitude and a person who does not have additions like drinking alcohol, chewing gutka etc. Helper cum Night Watchman - Children home, Piduguralla: 7th class pass/ fail. 3 years experience in cooking and house hold duties, especially work in Institutions (physical fitness certificate required). | The age limit for all posts is 25 to 44 years.

selection_process: Selection is restricted to Female Local Candidates only. Only qualified short-listed candidates will be called for an interview.
important_instructions: Only Female Local Candidates are eligible to apply. The position is purely on Contract, out sourcing, and part-time basis. Applications arriving late will not be accepted. The Collector & District Magistrate/Chairman Palnadu District reserves the right to cancel the notification at any time without assigning any reasons.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under DWCWEO Palnadu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across various posts including Asst. cum Data Entry Operator, Social Worker, Ayah, Chowkidar, and Helper cum Night Watchman.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 23 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, either directly or by registered post, to the designated office in Narasaraopet.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 25 and 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only Female Local Candidates who meet the specific educational and experience requirements for each post are eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Social Worker-cum-Early Child Educator post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for the Social Worker-cum-Early Child Educator post is Rs. 18,536 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely on a contract, outsourcing, and part-time basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the District Women and Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Chaakirala Mitta, Barampet, Narasaraopet, Palnadu District - 522601.
